lines.speaker: Harry Potter
lines.text: This tunnel goes straight up to the seventh floor, if the map is right. We can dodge Filch and reach the tower before midnight.
lines.expression: crouching low, wand tip lighting the damp stone as he gestures ahead

lines.speaker: Draconia Malfoy
lines.text: You expect me to crawl through filth because you kicked a grate open? My robes are ruined and Pansy holds my father's wrath in an envelope.
lines.expression: jaw tight, brushing dust from her sleeve while refusing to meet his eyes
